name: Laura Jane Musser Fund Environmental Initiative Program
summary: Planning and implementation grants for community-based projects that protect or restore ecosystems on public open space, in Colorado, Hawaii, Minnesota, Wyoming and part of North Carolina.

geography.label: Colorado, Hawaii, Minnesota, Wyoming and 23 North Carolina mountain counties

eligibility.rule: If a nonprofit, does not use a fiscal sponsor
Project is in a publicly owned or legally defined public access space
Involves active participation of local community members
Contains measurable outcomes within the first 12-18 months
Includes a long-term financial and environmental sustainability plan
Completes the project within 18 months of the grant award
Seeks either planning or implementation funds in one grant period
Does not request auto facilities, buildings, land acquisition or advocacy

documents: Board of Directors list with affiliations and terms
Letters of support from community members and the involved local government entity
Organizational budget or departmental budgets for the previous and current year
Balance sheet from the most recent completed year
501(c)(3) IRS letter or local-government endorsement letter

eligibility.quote: organizations with fiscal sponsors are not eligible
FOCUS on protecting/restoring a sustainable ecosystem, or conserving habitat biodiversity within a publicly owned open space or legally defined public access space
INVOLVE ACTIVE PARTICIPATION of local community members, with a particular appreciation for volunteer and youth engagement and stakeholder contributions
CONTAIN measurable outcomes within the first 12-18 months
Include a PLAN for the long term financial and environmental sustainability of the proposed program
the project must be completed within 18 months of the grant award
Projects will be eligible for either planning or implementation funds during any one grant period

Building or repair of parking lots, driveways, or other facilities for auto use. Designing, constructing or repairing buildings located in public open spaces. Projects requesting funds for land acquisition costs. Advocacy

after_award.quote: Yes. The Musser Fund requests that you provide a final report at the end of your grant period.

documents.quote: Please include a staff list identifying the organization's leaders and the experience they bring to the organization. ORGANIZATIONAL CHART Please include an organizational chart. BOARD OF DIRECTORS Please include a list of the Board of Directors, their affiliations and their terms.
Please include a letter of support from the local government entity that is most closely involved with your project. (This is in addition to the 2-4 community letters of support.)
Please include a map of the "open space" site as it relates to your community.

PROJECT BUDGET please include expense and revenue detail, also include revenue sources, amounts, and what is secured and what is pending. ORGANIZATIONAL BUDGETS (or if a public entity, departmental budgets) - for the previous year and for the current year.
BALANCE SHEET Please provide your organization's balance sheet from the most recent completed year. 990 Please provide your organization's most recent 990 tax form.

Please include a copy of your 501(c)(3) letter from the IRS. If you are a unit of local government, please provide a detailed letter of endorsement for the project on agency letterhead, signed by a head officer of your unit of government.
